en.title: Movify.pe - Web Quoting System Improvement
en.shortDescription: Improvement of the web quoting system.
en.description: From October to December 2021, I improved the interface of the web quoting system by integrating a custom style for Google Maps and establishing a new UI/UX for each step of the quote and email template. I migrated an iframe to a WordPress plugin for better update management. I developed functions for capturing leads and audit data.
